design_source.identical_to_template: datasets, split_seed, outer_folds, outer_repeats, inner_folds, fit_seeds, candidate_budget, candidate_seed, candidate_tie_rule, stochastic_finalists, selection_metric, failure_policy, aggregation_integrity, freeze_requirement, paired_interval, parallelism, confidence, test_train_ratio, numeric_threads_per_worker, report_metrics, device, historical_results, full_method, primary_family_size, multiplicity

removed_from_template.training_controls: the training controls block and its reference to the knn run; this family declares projected_control, whose references pin both the knn run and the knn_training run

full_method.resolution: embed_dim=clip(round(base*embed_scale),8,128); degree=max(1,base+degree_offset) lowered while comb(n_features+degree,degree)>10000; augment=base_augment and n_train>=150; resolved at fit time from the training partition only

projected_control.candidate_source: full_method.candidate_grid (the 16 candidates of arrowflow_full_knn) projected onto model.candidate_keys, duplicates removed, canonical config_id order: the four candidates of input_footrule_knn (projected_knn.projected_candidates, which is knn_controls.control_candidates('input_footrule_knn'))
projected_control.comparison: python -m experiments.make_revision.compare_runs projected --projected-source <this run> --knn-source <knn run> --training-source <knn_training run> --output <directory>; compare_runs projected-pairing checks the prepared directory against both reference runs before the run

contrasts.interval: fitting seeds averaged within each outer fold; corrected resampled t over the 15 outer folds (evaluation.paired_corrected_interval, q = test_train_ratio, 14 df)
contrasts.members: per dataset in panel order: input_footrule_knn minus projected_numeric_knn (the effect of sorting), then arrowflow_full_knn minus projected_numeric_knn
contrasts.multiplicity: one Holm adjustment across all 14 members (evaluation.holm_adjust)
contrasts.pairing: identical datasets, dataset_hash, splits_hash, outer schedule, fit_seeds and nested design keys across the three runs, and the knn_training design keys copied (compare_projected.DESIGN_COPY_KEYS); all three runs re-verified with the harness validators before any contrast; every source sealed by two or more environment records byte-identical (compare_runs.SHARED_SOURCES sealed by all three, knn_controls.py by the training and projected runs); projected_numeric_knn candidates equal to input_footrule_knn candidates of the knn_training run and to the projection of the knn run arrowflow_full_knn candidates
contrasts.sources: input_footrule_knn outer model rows of the knn_training run and arrowflow_full_knn outer model rows of the knn run (summary.json model_rows, re-verified); neither is refitted

descriptive.definition: per dataset, numeric_knn (knn run: tuned numeric kNN on imputed, standardized raw features; deterministic, one fitting seed) minus projected_numeric_knn accuracy, fitting seeds averaged within fold; corrected resampled t interval over the outer folds (q = test_train_ratio, 14 df) without a p value: the effect of expansion, projection and the seven-view vote without sorting
descriptive.status: descriptive; outside the Holm family; no p values

projected_control.ladder_table: per dataset, mean outer error, outer-fold SD and within-fold seed SD of each rung from its own verified summary.json (compare_projected.ladder_error_table)

dropped.augment: the resolved augmentation acts only on training samples
dropped.validation_ratio: the validation checkpoint acts only during training

model.encoders: the seven encoders of input_footrule_knn: view v is OrdinalEncoder(full_method.view_strategy_cycle[v mod 3], embed_dim, degree, lda_ratio 0.3, seed derive_seed(fit seed, "view", v)) fitted on the training rows of the fit (imputation, polynomial expansion when degree > 1, standardization, projection, and for calibrated views the calibration scaler)
model.presort_check: score_order of the scores equals OrdinalEncoder.transform of the same rows exactly, on the training rows of every fit and on every query; otherwise the fit or prediction fails (PresortMismatch)
model.representation: per view, the real-valued score matrix the view's OrdinalEncoder passes to arrowflow.ranking.score_order in transform: _scores_from_scaled(scaler_.transform(poly_.transform(imputer_.transform(X)))), poly_ only when degree > 1; _scores_from_scaled is the encoder's projection (for target_aware views the LDA block over lda_scale_ beside the random block over random_scale_) followed, for calibrated views, by the encoder's own calibration StandardScaler fitted on the training rows; no further standardization
model.resolution: embed_dim and degree as full_method.resolution, from the training partition's shape at fit time (bridge.resolve); the resolved augment is dropped

readout.classifier: StableNumericKNN: scipy cdist cityblock (p = 1) or euclidean (p = 2) to the training scores; a stable sort of each distance row, so a cutoff tie goes to the earlier training row in source order; the votes of StableFootruleKNN.predict_neighbors (uniform, or inverse distance with exact zero distances taking all the weight; a vote tie goes to the lowest class)
readout.selection: mean accuracy over StratifiedKFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=derive_seed(view_seed, "readout_selection")) splits of the training partition inside every fit, the splits input_footrule_knn's readout selection uses for the same view seed and rows; fewer splits only if the smallest class has fewer rows; one neighbour cache per split and p at the largest k; ties lowest_canonical_config_id; refit on the full training scores
readout.source: projected_knn.select_numeric_readout inside every fit, outside the candidate budget: multiview.select_knn_readout with the Minkowski order p added; the grid is the numeric_knn comparator grid (comparisons.CONVENTIONAL_GRIDS["numeric_knn"])

knn.run: .superpowers/sdd/2026-09-12-arrowflow-story-restoration-plan/runs/2026-09-12-bridge-knn (735 jobs; summary.json model_rows hold the per-fold, per-seed outer metrics of arrowflow_full_knn and numeric_knn)
